decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box builds directly on the firm's fluid-handling fabrication for utilities, so it fits the announced direction, and with only one year on the market weak results can still be blamed on start-up effects.

Public waste bins are far from the core and carry the highest risk, but the firm has just committed to them publicly as part of broadening its markets, so it will likely persist and attribute slow uptake to public procurement cycles.
Ground sleeves for posts use the firm's metal processing and serve public-sector buyers, and the firm has invested visibly in a sleeve line, so it is unlikely to retreat after one year.
The cast iron variant is part of the newly announced sleeve family, so dropping it would undercut the line the firm just launched, although it may overlap with the steel variant.
Steel ground sleeves match the firm's steel processing and in-house surface treatment strengths, which makes them the most natural member of the sleeve line to keep and defend.
